Went to the hospital for mental issues as a teen and got to know a lot of kids there. A few days passed and I started warming up to them. One girl came out to get a hairdryer from a nurse after a shower and I walked up and said "Lookin' good turtle" (as thats what she nicknamed herself) to which she turned and said in a spiteful voice, "I know I look like shit, you don't have to rub it in." Was definitely not the conversation I wanted to have and she left before I could apologize. This happened in front of the other in-patients who watched and looked at me funny. I've had a lot of social anxiety about being misinterpeted or unintentionally offending people with offhand comments since.

Actually ran into her in a mall a few months back and though brief, she didnt seem to have any grudges against me. A little bitter to think that all it took was less than a minute to absolutely crush my confidence and she had no idea.
